Alpha.description:
### Minimum viable product for the White Knuckle Archipelago.
### Use with caution. 
# 
Meant for feedback on how this plays due to me frankly playing way too much the past few days

To use, select White Knuckle in [r2modman](https://r2modman.com/download-latest/), select or create a profile, install BepInExPack from the mod browser, then open profile folder, navigate to /BepInEx/plugins, and unzip the WKRando.zip file in there. Upon pressing Start modded in r2modman, the game should launch in a modded state.

In game, you have access to the following commands for archipelago:

connect
reconnect
disconnect
resetapsave (used to reset specific data when starting a new multiworld of archipelago)
setdebuff (used to debug the amount of debuffs active at the current moment)

Known bugs at the moment:
Upon disconnecting/reconnecting, you will gain extra roaches/facility credits for each roach/facility credit item collected. (this is 2 am in the morning I'm going to fix this tomorrow) 

APWorld has no special options due to static logic for faster release.
Alpha.title: v0.0.0-alpha
